request.recipient: Intersect 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tx3 by TxPipe as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is intended to provide a standardized open-source interface to Cardano protocols through documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live RPC endpoints.
The proposal says there is currently no common interface mechanism across the Cardano ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and raising integration costs.
TxPipe has already put the developer layer into production with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry through Catalyst Fund 14.
The proposal funds 12 additional protocol onboardings, at a pace of 3 per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage.
The proposal claims agent-facing infrastructure such as an MCP server, per-protocol tools, skills, and LLM-structured documentation will help make Cardano protocols accessible to AI agents.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states the withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.

Treasury funds will be administered through Intersect-managed Sundae Labs smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, external oversight entities, sign-off thresholds, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month Tx3 open API and agent-infrastructure program, with stated deliverables, governance process references, NCL compliance, prior funding disclosures, and smart-contract-based treasury administration details.
